name: Remington Medical
old_description: Founded by Fred L. Aycock in 1992, Remington Medical Inc. specializes in medical devices. The maintenance, time, and money put into cleaning and sterilizing medical devices led us to develop some of the first disposable cables, some still in use today. Our business designs, manufactures, and distributes all our devices from our three facilities to save money and pass the savings onto our customers.
about:
Remington Medical was founded in 1992 by Fred L. Aycock in Alpharetta, Georgia. The company began by developing disposable cables to address the maintenance, time, and cost burdens of cleaning and sterilizing reusable medical devices, with some of those early cable designs still in use today.

The company designs, manufactures, and distributes its medical devices from three facilities, bringing functions such as injection molding, tooling, and prototyping in-house to maintain control over the entire production process. Remington also operates as a contract manufacturer, providing customized solutions for clients that lack the capacity or desire to develop products internally.

Remington serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) across the medical device sector, with particular experience in Class II devices. Its contract manufacturing customers come from a variety of clinical specialties, and the company supports projects ranging from prototype development through full-scale production.

Remington emphasizes that keeping all manufacturing functions under one roof yields a superior product and allows cost savings to be passed to customers. The firm’s ISO 13485 certification underscores its commitment to quality management for medical devices.
